Hi Emma — great to hear you're ready. Short answer up front: you can start with a single master PO and accompanying evidence binder; we will route a consolidated PO for marketplace activation in most cases, but there are two conditions where separate POs may be needed (AWS GovCloud or explicit regional billing/legal segregation).

Here's a minimal checklist to unblock listing and billing activation:
- Signed Marketplace Seller Agreement (we'll send the draft)
- Signed PO (we accept a single master PO; see template)
- Completed tax form (W-9 for US entities)
- Security attestation (completed security-attestation-form.docx)
- Technical contact and IAM role details for AWS/GCP (instructions in the Drive link)
- Contact & invoicing info (billing address + AP contact)

Targets:
- Documentation received: within 7 business days
- PO received and countersigned: within 14 business days
- Billing activation on marketplace: typically 5-10 business days after PO + W-9 are processed by marketplace accounting

I've attached the Redwood marketplace PO template (redwood_marketplace_po_template_v2.pdf) and our security attestation form. Vanessa (vendor ops) and Ben (finance ops) are looped in to help with PO routing and exceptions. If you anticipate delays on tax/finance sign-off, tell us and we'll open an exception window for the listing cadence.

Next steps:
1) Fill the PO template with your legal name + remit address and send back signed PDF.
2) Return W-9 and completed security attestation.
3) Share a 30-min slot for a short PO handoff call (Vanessa will coordinate).

Best,
Mina Haddad

Redwood Inference
